questions.question: Food production can be increased by
questions.explanation:
Food production can be increased by increasing crop yield per unit area, using:

Improved/high-yielding varieties (HYV)

Proper irrigation and fertilizers

Modern agricultural practices

Crop protection from pests and diseases

Multiple cropping and efficient use of land


👉 In NCERT/NEET context, crop improvement through plant breeding is a major way to increase food production.

questions.question:
Isolated protoplasts from two different varieties of plants – each having a 
desirable character can be fused to get hybrid protoplasts. These are known as 
_____ and this process is known as _____
questions.explanation:
Hybrid cells (somatic hybrids) — Somatic hybridisation

So the sentence becomes:

> Isolated protoplasts from two different varieties of plants are fused to get hybrid protoplasts, known as somatic hybrids, and this process is called somatic hybridisation.

questions.question: Pro-insulin contains :
questions.explanation:
Pro-insulin contains an extra peptide chain called the C-peptide (connecting peptide).

👉 Pro-insulin = A-chain + B-chain + C-peptide

During maturation, C-peptide is removed, leaving the functional insulin molecule containing A and B chains linked by disulfide bonds.

questions.question: Which of the following proteins is present in human Milk ?
questions.explanation:
α-lactalbumin → present in human milk; helps in lactose synthesis.

Lactoferrin → also an important protein in human milk, with antimicrobial/iron-binding functions.

questions.question: Indian Patents Bill, that takes such issues into consideration. This include;
questions.explanation:
The Indian Patents Bill took into consideration issues related to biopiracy and protection of traditional knowledge.

Examples include:

Turmeric — wound-healing properties

Neem — pesticidal properties

Basmati rice — traditional variety/knowledge


👉 Key answer: Protection against biopiracy and exploitation of India's traditional biological resources/knowledge.

questions.question:
‘X’ is a single stranded DNA or RNA, tagged with a radioactive molecule and is 
used to detect mutated gene. Identify ‘X’.
questions.explanation:
A probe is a short, single-stranded DNA or RNA molecule, labelled with a radioactive marker (or other detectable label), that binds to its complementary sequence and helps identify a specific or mutated gene

plasmid is extrachromosomal Double stranded circular DNA

questions.question:
Transgenic crops are modified through genetic engineering to develop natural 
resistance to insect pests.
which of the following is/are transgenic plant(s) ?

Why is genetically engineered insulin considered better for human diabetic 
patients than insulin which is isolated from animals?
questions.option_a: Insulin expressed in bacterial cells are of low molecular weight
questions.option_b: Insulin from other animals is not pure
questions.option_c: Genetically engineered insulin will not elicit immune response in the human body
questions.option_d: Genetically engineered insulin is easily transported through the bloodstream
questions.explanation:
Genetically engineered (recombinant) human insulin is considered better because:

It is identical to human insulin, so it causes fewer allergic or immune reactions.

Animal insulin (from pig/cow) differs slightly in amino-acid sequence and may cause allergic reactions.

Recombinant insulin can be produced in large quantities with consistent purity.


👉 NEET key point: Recombinant human insulin is less immunogenic than animal-derived insulin.

questions.question:
The novel strategy of ___ was adopted to prevent Meloidogyne incognita
infection in tobacco plants
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is RNA interference (RNAi).

👉 A novel strategy of RNA interference (RNAi) was used to prevent Meloidogyne incognita infection in tobacco plants.


RNAi → silencing of specific genes → protection against nematode infection.

questions.question:
Which of the following transgenic human protein products has been used to 
treat emphysema?
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is α-1-antitrypsin (alpha-1-antitrypsin). 

It is a transgenic human protein used to treat emphysema, particularly in patients with α-1-antitrypsin deficiency.

NEET key point:
α-1-antitrypsin → treatment of emphysema.

questions.question:
Golden rice is a transgenic crop of the future with which of the following 
improved traits?
questions.explanation:
Golden Rice is genetically modified to produce β-carotene (provitamin A) in the rice endosperm.

👉 Golden Rice → β-carotene → Vitamin A precursor → helps prevent Vitamin A deficiency.

questions.question:
The genetic defect – adenosine deaminase (ADA) deficiency may be cured 
permanently by;
questions.option_b: periodic infusion of genetically engineered lymphocytes having functional ADA cDNA
questions.option_d: introducing bone marrow cells producing ADA into cells at early embryonic stages
questions.explanation:
NEET key point:

In ADA deficiency, functional ADA gene is introduced into the patient's bone marrow cells. If corrected cells are introduced into the body, the treatment can provide long-term correction.

👉 Permanent cure: Gene therapy involving insertion of the functional ADA gene into stem cells.

questions.question: The Bt Toxic is not toxic to plants because :
questions.option_a: the pro Bt toxin activation requires temperature
questions.option_b: the Bt toxin recognizes only human-specific targets
questions.option_c: the Bt toxin formation from pro Bt toxin requires pH lower than that present in plants
questions.option_d: conversion of pro Bt toxin to Bt toxin takes place only in alkaline medium
questions.explanation: Bt toxin (Cry protein) is produced as an inactive protoxin in Bacillus thuringiensis. It becomes active in the alkaline gut of insects, where it binds to specific receptors in the insect midgut and causes cell lysis.
